description_en: Retrieves the current valid static access token for a specified user and a single cloud desktop under the current account, keeping the original expiration time
description_zh: 获取当前账号下指定用户及单台云电脑对应的当前有效静态访问令牌，保持原到期时间
name: GetLatestThirdAppAccessToken

parameters.help_en: The WyId of the user used when the token was created. It must correspond to the current account and the target cloud desktop, and cannot be replaced by a username
parameters.help_zh: 创建令牌时使用的用户 WyId。应与当前账号及目标云电脑对应，不能使用用户名代替
parameters.name: authorizer_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the cloud desktop specified when the token was created. You must provide a non-empty value that is consistent with the value used during creation. Asterisks (*) are not allowed
fields.help_zh: 创建令牌时指定的云电脑 ID。调用时必须提供非空值，并与创建时保持一致；不能使用星号（*）
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The resource type. This parameter is required. Valid value: DESKTOP, which indicates a cloud desktop. The value is case-insensitive
fields.help_zh: 资源类型。调用时必须提供，取值为 DESKTOP，表示云电脑；取值忽略大小写
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The target single cloud desktop resource. You must provide this object along with ResourceType and ResourceId when calling this operation. Pass it as a JSON object to specify only one cloud desktop. Wildcards or authorization for all cloud desktops are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 目标单台云电脑资源。调用时必须提供此对象及 ResourceType、ResourceId。以 JSON 对象传入，仅指定一台云电脑；不支持通配符或全部云电脑授权
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The business channel. Valid values: Enterprise and Business. The value is case-insensitive. If omitted, the default value is Enterprise. If an empty string or other value is explicitly passed, a parameter error is returned. This parameter does not replace user identity verification
parameters.help_zh: 业务渠道。取值：Enterprise（企业版）或 Business（商业版），忽略大小写。省略时默认为 Enterprise；显式传入空字符串或其他值时返回参数错误。该参数不替代用户身份校验
parameters.name: business_channel

schema.description_en: The access token and expiration information returned when the call is successful
schema.description_zh: 调用成功时返回的访问令牌及到期信息

AccessToken.description_en: The current valid static access token for the specified user and single cloud desktop. The original saved token is returned, and the query does not renew the token. This is a sensitive credential. Do not log or expose the full value
AccessToken.description_zh: 指定用户和单台云电脑对应的当前有效静态访问令牌。返回已保存的原令牌，查询不续期；属于敏感凭证，请勿记录或公开完整值

ExpiresAt.description_en: The absolute expiration time of the token, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is not empty when the call is successful. GetLatestThirdAppAccessToken returns the original expiration time and does not renew the token
ExpiresAt.description_zh: 令牌绝对到期时间，采用 Unix 毫秒时间戳。调用成功时非空；GetLatestThirdAppAccessToken 返回原到期时间，不续期
ExpiresAt.title_en: Token绝对截止时间，Unix毫秒；成功时非空，查询不续期
ExpiresAt.title_zh: Token绝对截止时间，Unix毫秒；成功时非空，查询不续期

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位和排查问题
